subject: Cost by endpoint + model (for chargeback / finance)
body:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@heliochat.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Wu <lena@heliochat.ai>
Date: Sun, Jan 18, 2026 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Cost by endpoint + model (for chargeback / finance)

Hey Priyom,

We’re trying to get ahead of spend and internal chargeback.

Is there (or will there be soon) a way in Redwood Console (or via API/export) to see cost broken down by:
- endpoint/route (e.g., /v1/chat/completions vs /v1/embeddings)
- model (incl. model version / alias)

The key thing we’re missing is *what’s driving* the change week-to-week. Finance keeps asking why this route spiked and we can’t answer without pulling raw logs.

Nice-to-haves:
- tokens in/out per route+model
- cache hit/miss rate
- retries/fallbacks (if those inflate cost)
- CSV export that we can drop into our BI tool
- totals that match the invoice

If this is on your roadmap, what’s the expected timeline / beta?

Thanks,
Samir

—
Samir Gupta
Head of Engineering, HelioChat



From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@heliochat.ai>
Cc: Lena Wu <lena@heliochat.ai>
Date: Sun, Jan 18, 2026 at 11:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Cost by endpoint + model (for chargeback / finance)

Samir — yes, this is actively in flight.

We’re building “Usage Insights” in Console to attribute usage + cost by route + model, with drivers like tokens (in/out), cache behavior, retries/fallbacks, and context length distribution. We’re also planning CSV export and a “what changed?” view that calls out week-over-week deltas.

A couple quick questions so we can make sure the beta fits your workflow:
1) Do you need this per workspace/project, or just at the org level?
2) Any constraints on who can see cost (eng only vs finance)?
3) Would you prefer a weekly exported report, or ad-hoc downloads are fine for now?

If you’re open to it, I can get you on the beta allowlist as soon as it’s ready and we can do a 30-min working session to validate that the breakdowns reconcile to your invoice.

Priyom

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: HelioChat asking for cost by endpoint + model (chargeback/finance)

Confirming where we’re at:

Beta target: early March (staged rollout behind feature flag + allowlist).

What HelioChat will get in beta (assuming allowlisted):
- Breakdown tables by route (normalized) + model (family/version bucketed)
- Driver columns: tokens in/out, cache hit/miss, retries/fallbacks attribution (where signals are reliable)
- “Top cost drivers” card + basic “what changed” deltas vs previous period
- CSV export (async export job + signed download link)
- Freshness indicator + lag warnings

Known constraints to set expectations:
- Data lag: up to ~24h in worst case; we’re adding banners when partial.
- Long ranges: 30-day queries may time out for large workspaces until perf hardening lands; we’ll recommend smaller ranges for interactive use.
- OpenAI-compat routes: route normalization mapping is improving; some edge cases may appear as “unknown route” if instrumentation is missing (we’re fixing).
- Reconciliation: totals should align with billing within tolerance; we’re tightening rounding/timing drift in the reconciliation tests.

Permissions:
- Cost view + export will be RBAC-gated; workspace setting to hide cost for non-admin roles.

I’m fine adding HelioChat to the beta list; they’ll be a great validation partner.

Dylan

—
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Lead, Console & Tooling | Redwood Inference

We’re targeting an early March beta for “Usage Insights” in Console that will include:

If you’re willing, I’d love to include HelioChat in the beta allowlist. Next step: 30 mins with you + whoever owns finance reporting (Lena?) so we can confirm the exact grouping you need (org vs workspace/project) and validate invoice reconciliation.

Does Thu or Fri work?

Priyom
